Best practices to create platform-first content
➔ Understand user-behaviour on different platforms.
Customers on LinkedIn are consuming industry related valuable content. The same audience
goes to Twitter to share their opinion on industry through short tweets and interact with other
experts in their industry, and searches on YouTube and Google for in-depth explainer content.
➔ Use native formats to your benefit.
When on LinkedIn, make use of picture+text, and avoid link in captions.
When on Twitter, avoid single post-like treatment, and make use threads with links.
When on YouTube, keep video content to the point and use cards and links in description.
➔ Don’t expect users to leave the platform.
f5072038-e3b5-40de-8d49-c074fe5015d6_chu.content_summary: This section outlines best practices for creating content tailored to specific platforms by understanding user behavior and utilizing native formats effectively.

f5072038-e3b5-40de-8d49-c074fe5015d6_chu.content:
➔ Don’t expect users to leave the platform.
Putting up a blog article on the website and just posting a picture of the topic asking viewers to
visit the website to read will not work. Repurpose content to make it platform native.
Confidential © 2022 Red & Blue Digital Private Limited. All rights reserved.
f5072038-e3b5-40de-8d49-c074fe5015d6_chu.content_summary: Users should not be expected to leave the platform for content. Instead, content should be repurposed to fit the platform's native format for better engagement.

Video - #TheRealityCheck
Insight: Leaders often overlook the people aspect of the project.
Solution: Jolt them into realizing the on-ground reality.
Idea: A social experiment video.
Execution:
➔We ask executive leaders about a newly developed
digitization program they’ve launched for their company,
and they sound confident about its success.
➔They are then shown CCTV footages of their employees
struggling to work with the software and systems.
➔Closing message communicates the importance of keeping
talent transformation aligned with digital transformation
Confidential © 2022 Red & Blue Digital Private Limited. All rights reserved.
f5072038-e3b5-40de-8d49-c074fe5015d6_chu.content_summary: This section outlines a social experiment video concept aimed at highlighting the disconnect between executive leaders' perceptions and the actual challenges faced by employees during a digitization program.
